facts.statement: The official Spanish-language news post promotes new Free Realms commercials shown on television and links to a new video.
facts.quote: ¿No has visto los nuevos comerciales de Free Realms en la televisión? ¡Checa el nuevo video aquí!

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A short Spanish-language official news post (freerealms.com) promoting new Free Realms TV commercials and a video. Its headline is 'Un Espacio en la TV: Free Realms y las Festividades', but the captured text says nothing about the festivities themselves. The post carries no mechanics, quests, prices or dates beyond its relative posting age.
